evidence: Committed static baseline: solution/app contains the full golden (server.js, src/bootstrap.js, src/db.js, src/index.js, src/seed_data.json, public/*); solve.sh only does `cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/` plus a guarded rm of the DB files (no npm install, curl, git clone, codegen or build step). package.json pins exact express 5.1.0 / better-sqlite3 12.4.1, preinstalled in the image. Raw-evidence index source hashes for all 12 solution files match the frozen bytes. Seeding is deterministic: db.js:10 reads the seed from beside the module (src/seed_data.json, byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json, sha256 a1c65c80...3740); db.js:61-86 seedIfEmpty inserts users/jobs/applications with the seed's fixed ids and positions, application created_at hard-coded '2026-06-15T09:00:00Z' (db.js:75), messages and notes use the seed's own created_at, message ids are AUTOINCREMENT in seed-array order, and read markers resolve read_count to those ids (db.js:82-83). No Math.random, Date, fetch or env-dependent value enters seeded rows. Every pinned figure the criteria quote derives from these rows: functional prompt Z quotes Applied 'Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi' / Screen 'Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz' (seed positions APP-105/106/108 = APPLIED 1/2/3, APP-103/104 = SCREEN 1/2), Lena's unread 1 (seed reads), Noor's note text (seed notes), the 120-message Noor thread paged 30 at a time (thread_page_size 30). Within each seeded thread the created_at values are strictly increasing and unique (checked APP-101 120, APP-201 3, APP-301 3, APP-302 1), so id order and timestamp order agree. Nondeterministic sources exist only for runtime-created records and none moves a graded figure: index.js:59 now()=new Date().toISOString() stamps sessions, activity, actions, notes, messages and new applications created during grading; index.js:60 uid() uses crypto.randomBytes(3) for new JOB-/APP- ids; index.js:88 random session tokens. Ordering never uses these timestamps for staff views (board ORDER BY job_id, stage, position; activity/actions/messages by integer id); the candidate list uses ORDER BY created_at, id where seeded rows share one fixed timestamp and runtime rows are later. Client public/js/app.js:21 formats ISO times with en-GB/timeZone UTC, a fixed locale/zone. No graded rule is time-dependent: instruction.md, hireops_rules.md and all judge prompts contain no clock, date, deadline or age rule, so a fixed clock is not part of this task's contract and its absence is not a defect. Adversarial alternatives: a conforming app that orders threads by created_at instead of id gets the same seeded order (monotone, unique timestamps); a conforming app using wall-clock timestamps or random/UUID ids passes the same criteria because no criterion quotes a timestamp or an id. A broken golden variant (e.g. random seed positions or seeding from a network fetch) is not present. Runtime: the scripted golden run (results/workspace.json group 0 'seeded card order and internal notes are loaded' passed; group 23 'restart keeps ... without reseeding' passed) is consistent with the static analysis. Not measured: a second fresh-install comparison of seeded rows, but determinism is established by source inspection since no nondeterministic input reaches seeding. Latent P3 only (not a defect for this row): uid() has 2^24 values per prefix, so a collision during one grading DB is ~1e-5 to 1e-4 and would surface as a 500 on job/candidate creation; it does not affect any pinned value.
